en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Bashhar, 
from Abu Al Hassan<sup>asws</sup>
regarding the man who indicates upon the houses and the places, and he takes the (finder’s)  fee upon it. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘This is a renumeration. There is no problem with it’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Husayn ibn al-Bashshar who has said the following: “About the case of a broker who shows houses and assets for a certain amount of fee, abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, said it is not unlawful.’”
